{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk-blend blouse in a soft blush tone (#eaddcf), tailored with a relaxed collar and a slightly dropped shoulder line for effortless elegance, falling just below the hip in length.
Tailored wool-twill trousers in a deep espresso brown (#3b2f2f), cut straight through the leg with a subtle taper at the ankle to balance the silhouette comfortably on autumn evenings.
Leather ankle boots in cognac leather (#c78e5b) featuring a low block heel, designed to keep feet warm and secure while maintaining a polished look without being too dressy.
A delicate gold pendant necklace set against the blouse neckline adds a touch of subtle sparkle perfect for restaurant lighting, completing the ensemble with minimal fuss.
This outfit works because it bridges the gap between casual comfort and refined neatness suitable for an evening date at a casual restaurant. The warm autumnal colors of brown and cognac harmonize beautifully with her skin tone and hair, creating a cohesive and flattering look. The tailored yet relaxed cuts ensure she feels confident and unrestricted while maintaining an appropriate level of dressiness for the occasion."}
